Third-party code in this folder
===============================

nacl-fast.min.js
  TweetNaCl-js 1.0.3 (https://github.com/dchest/tweetnacl-js), the npm package's own
  minified build, unmodified. Used for Ed25519 key generation and request signatures.
  Public domain (The Unlicense): see tweetnacl-LICENSE.txt.
